scope: Original visual teaching specifications; not final anatomy, playback-ready assets or clinical review. Use existing 22 storyboard briefs and VA-01–05 references. No unsafe exercise demonstration without clinician-approved motion.

items.title: Surface moisture is not striae prevention
frames: Cross-section: epidermis above dermis; label surface barrier
Apply stylized moisturizer layer only to surface
Highlight deeper dermal striae as separate phenomenon
items.alt: A simplified skin cross-section separates surface hydration from changes deeper in skin.
items.safety: No guaranteed prevention or before/after transformation; schematic not to scale.

items.title: Gap and strength are different
frames: Front schematic of paired rectus muscles and linea alba
Mark an illustrative distance at a stated measurement site
Show separate strength and gap outcomes, not proportional geometry
items.alt: Two abdominal muscle columns are separated by connective tissue; width and muscle function are different measurements.
items.safety: Not a self-diagnosis method, not a cutoff or exercise clearance.

items.title: Contract and release
frames: Orient pelvis and pelvic floor using licensed VA-04 if appropriate
Conceptual upward movement and full release with two distinct arrows
Show pain or inability to relax as reason for assessment
items.alt: A conceptual pelvic floor illustration depicts contraction and relaxation as separate motions.
items.safety: No universal strengthening routine, no instruction to test by stopping urine; therapist review required.

items.title: Symptom-guided return to activity
frames: Healing and comfortable movement
Gradual increases when tolerated
Pause and seek guidance for warning signs; urgent symptoms bypass plan
items.alt: A non-linear path from recovery to activity with a separate safety exit.
items.safety: Not fixed dates or automatic eligibility; urgent symptoms require immediate care.

items.title: Read the prenatal label
frames: Show fictitious label with serving size
Separate food plus supplement, DFE vs folic acid, and DHA vs omega-3
Flag missing or duplicated nutrients without generating dose
items.alt: A fictional supplement label highlights the serving size and units that must be checked.
items.safety: No product recommendation or dose calculation.

items.title: Same ingredient, different pregnancy stage
frames: Separate trying, pregnancy, lactation, and later
Highlight hydroquinone pregnancy avoidance and unknown lactation exposure
Bakuchiol evidence gap and topical vs oral retinoids separated
items.alt: A stage timeline shows that skin ingredient evidence changes by pregnancy and breastfeeding status.
items.safety: No green safe badge for unknown; individualized exposure advice.

items.title: Pregnancy tissue changes and feeding autonomy
frames: Use schematic glandular tissue and support structures
Show variation rather than idealized shape
Feeding choices based on informed preference, not unsupported cosmetic promise
items.alt: A simplified breast anatomy schematic explains variation without ranking feeding choices.
items.safety: No appearance rating; anatomy and license review before use.

items.title: Swelling versus warning signs
frames: Show ordinary bilateral swelling as possible, not diagnostic
Separate one-sided painful swelling and breathing symptoms
Prominent immediate assessment exit
items.alt: A comparison illustrates why one-sided painful swelling and breathing symptoms need urgent assessment.
items.safety: Do not classify symptoms as harmless using a graphic.

production_acceptance: Plain-language text alternative and captions; essential safety outside player
No meaning solely through color; WCAG contrast, zoom and reduced-motion fallback
One concept per frame; no idealized bodies or promises; no invented percentages
Medical illustrator or relevant clinician checks labels, tissue layers and movement; confirm source evidence and rights
Original editable art; no copied noncommercial figures in commercial app without permission
Do not treat a visual brief as a reviewed demonstration or embed an unreviewed video
